source: OPCOM S.A., PZU (Day-Ahead Market) - Rapoarte / Curbe agregate, https://www.opcom.ro/rapoarte-pzu-curbe-agregate/ro
delivery_date: 2026-10-21 (Wednesday); SDAC delivery day 2026-10-20T22:00Z/2026-10-21T22:00Z = 00:00-24:00 CET = 01:00-01:00 Romanian time (EEST, UTC+3)

units.quantity_mwh: quantity_mw x 0.25 h (energy over one 15-minute interval)

construction: Price-elastic part = OPCOM aggregated curve of 15-minute (MTU) orders for that interval (XML SupplyCurve/DemandCurve, Resolution PT15M, Pos = OPCOM interval number). Points kept exactly as published (price, cumulative quantity), piecewise linear.
30-minute curves are empty (0 MW) on this day.

Price-inelastic offset, added as a horizontal segment at the price limit (supply at -600, demand at +4000), exactly as in OPCOM's own chart (PDF file): accepted block orders (XML BlockOrder, quantity x ActualAcceptanceRatio) + accepted 60-minute (period) orders + net cross-border flow (net import added to supply, net export added to demand).

Accepted 60-minute orders = 60-minute aggregated curve (PT60M) evaluated at the hourly average of the four official quarter-hour prices; this rule reproduces the official cross-border balance exactly for 61 of 96 intervals on this day, including both intervals chosen here (residual 0.0 MW).
Check: at the official clearing price, supply = demand (see supply_at_P_mw / demand_at_P_mw).
caveats: The OPCOM 'PIP si volum tranzactionat' report gives lower traded volumes (Q45: 1723.0 MW buy / 1380.0 MW sell) than the quantity at which the aggregated curves cross (Q45: 2816.1 MW). OPCOM does not document the difference; both figures are stored. Use opcom_pip_* as the official traded volume and curve_cleared_quantity_* as the crossing point of the published curves.
Price range -600 to +4000 EUR/MWh is the SDAC harmonised min/max; most of the curve shape lies between about -150 and 1000 EUR/MWh.
